findings.text: The brief's "Done when" asks for both harnesses to be re-run 3 times, but perf/report.md:20-21 gives one `freeze.mjs` run per mode (hand, fake mic) and three only for `load.mjs`. Both freeze results are 0 tasks over 50 ms, so the target looks met; two more freeze runs would make it as solid as the load numbers.

Ask 1's "skipped when the draft's height did not change" was not built. perf/report.md:35 explains why: the layout read now happens once inside the frame callback, so a height check saves nothing. The reasoning holds, and with this change anchor() runs once per frame during a replay instead of never.

`test/load.mjs` and `test/earlier.mjs` read `/ai/v-yxnts4l.jsonl` by default. That file still exists in the worktree, but the main tree's working copy shows it deleted (`git status`: ` D public/ai/v-yxnts4l.jsonl`). If that deletion is committed, both harnesses lose their default fixture. `freeze.mjs` already uses the dated copy at `/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/05/v-yxnts4l/session.jsonl`, and the other two should use it too.

`stall.mjs` (2 FAIL, "late" scenario) and `anchor.mjs` (1 FAIL) fail the same way on the untouched main tree, so this work did not cause them (perf/report.md:42). Nobody owns them yet. The dictation mastermind should file them as a task so they don't slip.

Known loss, documented in voice-assistant.md#nothing-jumps and perf/report.md:51: if a place or refined line in the shown part points at a bubble still behind "show earlier", it is never re-applied. This is acceptable for now. The fix would be to replay the held lines' targets in `Widget.Thread.load_earlier()` (Widget.js ~346).
